==Description==
'''Bunny Hop''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

When performed, the player, will start to hold a white bunny while jumping forward like a bunny.

This emote was obtainable at Level 16 of the Spring Frenzy Battle Pass premium track, which cost {{Bunz|480}} or {{Robux|107}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|3,800}} or {{Robux|1,182}}.
